name: Monster Ball
author: theNfan
description:
Deliver the balls to the target in time!

Monster Ball was initially created as the Counting Prototype for the Junior Programmer Pathway. 
However, things got way out of hand when I decided I want to learn how to make a physics-based truck and model it in ProBuilder.
